column3: Flat "<username> <capability>" list (issue|pr) of contributors whose issues/PRs bypass the auto-close gate; parsed by issue-gate.yml, pr-gate.yml and approve-contributor.yml.

Bug-report form: required "What happened?" and "Steps to reproduce" textareas, optional expected/version; preamble warns new-contributor issues auto-close and asks the reporter to re-check with `pi -ne` (no extensions) first.
Five lines: disables blank issues and routes questions to a Discord contact link.
Contribution Proposal form (what/why required, how optional) - the mandatory precursor to opening a PR for new contributors.
Third-party package abuse report form: package name/version, a report-type dropdown (malicious / impersonation / TOS), and details.
On an issue comment a maintainer writing `lgtm`/`lgtmi` (at start or end, after optional @mentions) rewrites .github/APPROVED_CONTRIBUTORS in place and commits it; lgtm = pr, lgtmi = issue.

The release pipeline: source archive -> per-platform binaries -> smoke test on ubuntu/macos/windows -> DRAFT GitHub Release -> npm publish -> pi.dev announcement -> publish the release -> delete the draft on any failure.
Plain CI: npm ci --ignore-scripts, build, check, build the env daemon, npm test; plus an MCP client conformance job against a pinned baseline.
Cross-compiles the Rust pi-env daemon for 8 targets (incl. Android) on native runners and uploads each as a pi-env-<platform> artifact.

Path-filtered matrix job for the execution env: rust fmt/clippy/test, durable env tests, pi-env tests, plus a Windows-OpenSSH leg re-running the SSH test with cmd.exe and then PowerShell as the default shell.

Runs the repo's /is prompt headless on a labelled issue (staff-only, org-membership verified), then exports the session to HTML, uploads it to a private gist and comments a `pi "/ir <gist>"` import line.
Auto-closes a new issue whose author is neither a collaborator nor in APPROVED_CONTRIBUTORS, labelling it untriaged and closing as not_planned.
Label-driven triage: certain labels auto-assign an owner and reopen; adding `last-read` bulk-closes the untriaged issues in that range as no-action.
Builds the flake on 3 systems against a pinned model-catalog revision, fast-forwards the `stable` branch to a release tag, and auto-commits a refreshed catalog pin to main.
Daily npm audit of production deps plus `npm audit signatures` (registry signature verification), installed with --ignore-scripts.
Auto-closes a PR whose author is not a collaborator and lacks `pr` capability in APPROVED_CONTRIBUTORS, with a message explaining the lgtm flow.
Generates the model catalog, validates it against the latest release, and uploads it to R2 only inside a Mon-Fri 10:00-15:00 Europe/Vienna window.
Thirty-one lines that strip the `inprogress` label whenever an issue is closed.
`/ir` command: imports a CI issue-analysis session (gist id/URL, pi.dev share URL, issue URL, or a local .html/.jsonl), rewriting the recorded cwd to the local checkout and switching to it.

On `before_agent_start` regex-matches the prompt for a GitHub PR/issue/advisory URL, renders a TUI widget and renames the session from fetched `gh` metadata; rebuilds itself on session_start/session_switch.
Registers `/tui`, which reads `tui.fullRedraws` inside a `ctx.ui.custom` block and notifies the count.
Times the turn via agent_start/agent_end and notifies tokens/sec plus input/output/cache-read/cache-write token counts.
Two-line ignore-everything file that keeps the per-user git config directory out of version control.
Same two-line ignore-all file for the per-user npm config directory.
Changelog-audit prompt: finds the last tag, walks commits, checks each package's [Unreleased] section, and enforces cross-package duplication into coding-agent.
Simplify-a-workpackage prompt with an explicit approval gate listing what counts as a "significant removal" and requiring user sign-off before deleting.
Duplicate-finder prompt: defines what counts as a duplicate vs merely related, and forbids posting, labelling or closing.
Issue-analysis prompt: adds the inprogress label (skipped under CI), reads the issue with gh, and forbids trusting the issue's own root-cause analysis.
PR-review prompt with a fixed output shape (What it does / Good / Bad / Ugly / Tests / Open questions) and an explicit ban on checking out the PR branch.
Security-advisory prompt: fixed frontmatter contract, an explicit "do not invent API endpoints" rule for advisory comments, and a "request_cve only if the draft says so" safety rule.
Wrap-up prompt: changelog -> one final comment ending with an exact disclaimer line -> commit only session-touched files -> branch check -> push -> close the issue with reason completed.
Checklist for adding a provider to packages/ai, including the required test-matrix files and the lazy-registration rule.
Router skill: maps a request to the right .pi/prompts template and restates the rules that travel with it (analyze-only for is.md, no branch checkout for pr.md, one comment per session for wr.md).
tmux recipe for driving the TUI (fixed 80x24 pane, send-keys, capture-pane) and the rule that a smoke test must submit a prompt and wait for the reply.
Release playbook: lockstep versioning, the local smoke test from /tmp, the release script invocation, and what CI does afterwards (OIDC npm publish, announcement marker, nix stable branch).
Thirteen-line esbuild entry importing only the Anthropic provider, used to prove the agent bundle tree-shakes other providers and SDKs.

Developer wrapper symlinked onto PATH as `pi`; resolves through symlinks to the checkout, runs dist/bundle/cli.js with PI_EXPERIMENTAL=1, and delegates to the stable binary for `--stable` or `update`.
Runs Biome natively, or falls back to the WASM build on platforms with no native binary (Android/Termux), replaying biome.json's include/negated globs over `git ls-files`.
GritQL rule that flags any direct `model.type === "chat"` comparison and points at isModelType/getModelType, because chat models may omit `type`.
Browser-safe esbuild entry touching the compat layer, agent, chord and a queued steering message, so a Node-only import breaks the bundle.
Local mirror of the release binary build: bun --compile per platform with --no-compile-autoload-bunfig/--no-compile-autoload-dotenv, native prebuilds, theme/assets, and tar.gz/zip archives.

esbuild bundler for the shipped CLI: splits lazy OAuth/bedrock entries, validates that every importOAuthModule() flow has a lazy entry, and forbids the codemode worker from importing anything but Node builtins.
Bundles three browser entries and asserts the esbuild metafile: durable's browser bundle excludes the node adapters, and the agent bundle contains only anthropic.json and @anthropic-ai/sdk.
Treats package `exports` as a cost contract: walks the value-import graph of each declared entry and enforces a maxFiles budget plus a `forbid` list; only value imports count.
Pre-commit gate: refuses a staged package-lock.json unless PI_ALLOW_LOCKFILE_CHANGE is set or the only changes are workspace package metadata, and prints a per-package diff summary.
Proves the catalog about to be published still type-checks against the latest released pi: unpacks the release tarball, merges its built-in models with the new catalog, and compiles pi-ai with tsc.
Builds an artifact set and, for every public package, installs it into an isolated consumer directory and smoke-tests it.
Requires exact versions for every direct dependency in dependencies/devDependencies/optionalDependencies, exempting workspace/file/git/url specifiers and npm: aliases.
node:test cases pinning the exact-version rule, incl. #10865 (caret ranges let an agent install an incompatible newer workspace dep) and npm: alias ranges.
TS-compiler-API check that every runtime import of a public package is a declared dependency, and that a file excluded from the build is not imported by the build.
node:test cases for the runtime-dep gate, incl. #9132 (workspace resolution masked a missing runtime dep) and the excluded-but-imported case.
AST scan forbidding relative `.js` specifiers in non-declaration .ts files (import, export, dynamic import, import type), parsed through one synthetic TS project.
Installs the packed coding-agent into a temp dir with a scrubbed HOME/PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR, asserts the public SDK exports exist and that the CLI's --version matches the manifest.
node:test that the SDK smoke test fails on an undeclared import even when the bundled CLI works (#9132).
Prints a per-day/per-provider cost breakdown from the session JSONL, decoding the timestamp out of the session filename.
Deterministic source tarball: rebuilds a git tree with the gitignored model data force-added, pins --mtime to the commit, then asserts a required-path list and that no path escapes the prefix.
Diffs the model catalog between HEAD (a detached worktree) and the working tree, per provider/model, with canonical JSON and a special sort for thinkingLevelMap.
Eight lines importing the durable package's public runtime-neutral entries so the browser bundle check sees them.
Measures edit-tool behaviour from session JSONL: separates the changed "core" of an edit from the re-sent wrapper, reports inflation ratios, failure kinds, and same-file multi-call clusters.
Generates the installer lockfile (package.json + lockfile v3) for the coding agent, with an allowlist for install-script packages and validation that every internal dep matches the release version.
Emits per-provider thinking-level capability JSON from a model catalog using getSupportedThinkingLevels().
One line ignoring the triage tool's local state directory (data/).
Category definition for turn execution: lifecycle, tool dispatch, orphan calls, abort, steering/queue, session retry; names what belongs elsewhere.
Category definition for the app shell: args, settings.json scopes, install/update, self-update, binaries, crash handling, startup time.
Category definition for codemode/tool_search: sandbox, worker, script APIs, only mode, classifier.
Category definition for context management: automatic/manual compaction, branch summaries, usage estimation, overflow recovery, compaction model settings.
Category definition for pi-durable and the new harness packages (durable, env, daemons, storage, chord).
Category definition for the extension API/runtime: pi.* and ctx.* surface, events, registerTool/Command/Provider, dialogs, jiti loading, /reload.
Category definition for the built-in MCP client: mcp.json, transports, OAuth, tool registration, /mcp.
Category definition for which models exist and which is selected: catalog, metadata, models.json, model resolution, /model contents and ranking.
Explicit "not a bucket for unsure" catch-all category for web-ui/mom/pods/telemetry/evals/spam/third-party.
Category definition for what pi tells the model: system prompt assembly, AGENTS.md context files, skills and prompt templates, prompt-cache stability.
Category definition for pi-ai wire behaviour: request building, tool schema conversion, SSE parsing, error classification/retry, usage parsing, auth and token refresh.
Category definition for embedding pi: createAgentSession, RPC mode/RpcClient, print and JSON modes, pi-ai/agent-core as libraries.
Category definition for session storage and navigation: JSONL format, SessionManager, resume/fork/clone, /tree, HTML export, session dirs.
Category definition for built-in tools: read/write/edit/bash/grep/find/ls, output truncation, shell spawning and timeouts, images in results.
Category definition for the terminal: rendering, scrollback/flicker/redraw cost, markdown and images, renderers and themes, key decoding, paste/IME.
Incremental local corpus of issues synced with gh (since last sync) plus an IDF-weighted keyword search over titles/bodies and per-author statistics.
Sync loop + HTTP server for the triage UI: token cookie auth with timingSafeEqual, /api/state, /api/sync, /api/retriage, /api/decide.
The triage agent's system prompt: issue text is untrusted, two required duplicate searches, a category decision rule with a low-confidence tie-break, p0/p1/none criteria and signal tags.
Documents the triage tool: sync -> triage (one durable conversation per issue) -> human review, the state files, env vars and the UI keys.
Three-line Node module register() hook that installs source-hooks.mjs so the tool runs TS workspace sources without a build.
Launches the triage server with `node --conditions=source --import ./scripts/issues/register.mjs`.
Module resolve hook that maps a workspace package's dist/*.js back to src/*.ts (with format module-typescript) so no build is needed.
The durable triage agent: one conversation per issue, a durable state document, three tools (search_issues, read_issue, submit_triage), bounded concurrency, and resume-after-restart.
Single-file web UI: inbox/decided/all views grouped by the agent's suggestion, keyboard triage (j/k, 0/1/n, o), 8s polling.
Wires an external consumer to a local artifact set (file: specifiers plus npm overrides or pnpm overrides) and smoke-tests that every export/main/types/bin resolves from the local tarball.
node:test that the consumer lockfile resolves from the local artifact (not the registry) and that pnpm installs offline with no https URLs.
Builds, packs and installs the release into isolated dirs outside the repo, for both Node and Bun, and prints how to run each.
The one constant naming the oldest pi that receives catalogs published from this checkout (1.2.1, with the kimi-coding reason).
node:test for the shared catalog protocol: key layout, semver ordering, revision selection (#9099), and the User-Agent redirect.
The protocol file copied byte-for-byte into pi.dev: storage layout, request parsing, revision selection by minimum version, and index validation.
npm audit wrapper with an explicit accepted-advisory table (each entry naming the package and why it does not apply) and a warning when an accepted entry no longer matches.
Cross-platform npm invocation: on Windows it runs process.execPath with npm_execpath instead of shelling out to npm.
CLI wrapper over produceArtifactSet with --out/--force/--offline-model-data/--skip-build, and prints the use-local-packages command.
node:test that the packaging CLIs reject a missing option value or an unsupported package manager BEFORE doing any work.
Packs every public package into content-addressed tarballs with a manifest, and refuses an output dir that is the repo, an ancestor, a root, or outside .artifacts.
node:test for the artifact set: content-addressed names, integrity mismatch detection, and the four refused output-directory shapes.
Recursively finds workspace package directories (skipping dist/ and node_modules/).
Startup benchmark for Node and Bun: warmup+measured runs, RPC mode times to a real get_state response, TUI mode times to first usable UI, parses per-phase startup timings and emits METRIC lines.
Validates the catalog bundle (shards must equal models.all.json, legacy must be the chat projection, >=500 models) and uploads revisions + index to S3/R2 idempotently.
node:test that the publication metadata carries chat/image/classifier/total counts separately.
Verifies every public package resolves at the exact release version on npm (with retries), then advances the R2 latest-version pointer under an ETag/if-none-match condition.
node:test for the pointer advance: never regress a newer marker, retry a lost conditional update, create a missing marker with if-none-match.
Publishes the packed tarballs with --provenance, skipping versions already on npm; refuses a non-lockstep version set.
Reads every session's read-tool calls and reports full vs partial reads, per provider/model and per time bucket, both raw and session-normalized.
Extracts the changelog section for a version and rewrites relative/floating links to the release tag; can also back-fix existing GitHub release notes.
Returns the non-private workspace packages with their directory, name and version.
The release script: clean tree, npm registration check, pin+build with the newest catalog, version bump, changelog rotation, checks/tests, commit+tag, push.
Windows-only reproduction of issue #5893, driving the real bash tool with ${name} expansion and a for-loop and asserting the exact output.
Measures context usage per session: max prompt tokens against the model's contextWindow, the percent at the first compaction, and compaction rate, by day and by model.
Extracts session transcripts for a cwd, splits them into 100k-char files, and can spawn pi subagents to mine recurring instructions into AGENTS.md entries, skills or prompt templates.
Runs the shipped binary against a local fake OpenAI-compatible server: the model must call codemode, the worker result must come back as a tool message, and the model must echo the success marker.
Per-day and per-provider token/cost totals from the session JSONL for a cwd, with a local-calendar-day window.
Enforces lockstep versioning across published packages and rewrites internal dependency ranges to exact versions, and keeps pi-ai's version constant in sync.
node:test for lockstep enforcement, exact internal pins, untouched registry aliases and generated manifests, and the pi-ai version constant.
Aggregates tool calls/results and estimated result tokens per tool (and per bash command prefix) from the session JSONL and renders an HTML report.
Refreshes the Nix model-catalog pin only when the pinned catalog no longer hydrates the checkout or the provider/type/api model groups differ from the live catalog.
node:test with a mocked pi.dev: pins the newest typed catalog, keeps a fresh pin, replaces one missing a model type or using a switched API, and keeps the old pin on every fetch failure.
One-line perl rewrite of relative .js import specifiers to .ts across package src directories.
Points an external project at a local artifact set for npm or pnpm, by rewriting its package.json/pnpm-workspace overrides.
